title: Deck config
description: Per-face card distribution for one seat count. Totals: 40 cards at 2 seats, 54 at 3, 64 at 4.

locations.description: Board-location id to number of copies. Key set widens with seat count: blue-banner cities at 3 seats, teal at 4, plus a second 4-only Uttoxeter.

industry.description: Single-industry card faces. Cotton and manufacturer have no single-face card; they appear only as the dual card below.

dual-cotton-manufacturer.description: Cards whose face allows either cotton or manufacturer. 0 at 2 seats, 6 at 3, 8 at 4.
